title: Context Window & Parameters
description: Master context windows, temperature, top-p sampling, and generation parameters for controlling LLM output.

data.text: Temperature controls randomness, top-p controls nucleus sampling, and context window limits input length. Understanding these parameters is essential for controlling output quality and consistency.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Context window limits total input + output tokens
data.takeaway: Generation parameters give you fine-grained control over LLM output. Tune temperature and top-p based on your use case: low for factual tasks, higher for creative tasks.
